newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE welcomes BBA euroLIBOR proposal.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE welcomes BBA euroLIBOR proposal.

text.p: The London Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) said on Wednesday it welcomed a proposal from the British Bankers' Association to publish a short-term reference rate for the euro.
LIFFE said BBA's LIBOR was the most widely used reference rate in the world, used by the German futures exchange and as the Chicago Mercantile Exchange.
The BBA earlier proposed a BBA euroLIBOR interest rate reference rate as a benchmark, replacing its EcuLIBOR from January 1, 1999.
LIFFE said the proposal would provide continuity of contracts pending European Economic and Monetary Union planned for 1999.
